title: George Bernard Shaw and Churchill: First Night Tickets
summary: Two tickets for opening night; bring a friend, if you have one. — Cannot make the first night; will come to the second, if there is one!
keywords: George Bernard Shaw and Churchill: First Night Tickets
full_text:
Historical Exchange featuring George Bernard Shaw.

"Two tickets for opening night; bring a friend, if you have one. — Cannot make the first night; will come to the second, if there is one!"

This celebrated moment in parliamentary and diplomatic history illustrates the timeless power of intellect, courage, and rhetorical brilliance.
